_readme: Mandatory questions by page type (red-team round 1). scripts/pack.py puts the sets that apply into each page's brief. Each page answers these PLUS at least 3 page-specific questions with a stated source (search query, user-group anxiety, Motilal teardown, client decision). A link to another page does not answer a MUST question.
every_page: Which Aikyam company provides this, and which company receives my details if I act here?
What does it cost me (a figure, or a visible placeholder until the rate card is approved)?
What happens after I click the main button?
account_opening: Which account am I opening here: trading and demat (Aikyam Capital), investing (Aikyam Wealth), or both?
How long does it take, and is it fully online?
What happens if my KYC fails or I stop halfway?
Is my data safe, and who is the KYC partner?
trading_fo: What can I lose? (the F&O risk box sits before the first F&O call to action)
Am I eligible for F&O, and what proof of income do I need?
What does each order cost (brokerage, statutory charges)?
Where do current lot sizes, margins and expiries come from? (link to the exchange; no figures from memory)
mutual_funds: Is this a regular plan through a distributor, and what does the distributor earn? (link to the commission disclosure)
Which ARN is the distributor registered under?
Are the returns shown assumptions or past data, and what is the risk?
Does the page suggest product categories only, never named schemes as advice?
calculator: What does this calculator assume (return rate, inflation, tax), and can I change it?
What is the formula, with a worked example?
What should I do next with this result?
partner: How are payouts worked out? (placeholder until Aikyam approves the payout grid)
What must partners never say or do (code of conduct)?
Which Aikyam company signs the agreement, and under which registration?
What are the steps from application to first client?
pms: Is PMS right for me (SEBI minimum ₹50 lakh, risk, lock-in, fees)?
Who manages the money (the third-party SEBI-registered portfolio manager), and what is Aikyam Wealth's role (empanelled distributor)?
What fees and exit loads apply? (placeholder until confirmed)
coming_soon: What is coming, and who is it for?
When will it be available, and how will I hear about it?
What can I do on ROOT today instead?
legal: When was this last updated, and which company does it apply to?
Where is the full official document (PDF download)?
Whom do I contact about it?
data: As of when is this data, and where does it come from?
What does each number mean (plain-English labels)?
How do I act on it on ROOT, and what does that cost?
company: Who is behind ROOT, and which licences does each company hold?
How can I verify these registrations myself?
How do I reach a real person?
